findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Inspector observed an employee not using appropriate barrier to shut off the faucet after handwashing. Education was provided. Ensure that employees are always aware to use a barrier after handwashing to avoid recontaminating their hands.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: No bare-hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed.
findings.comment: Inspector observed employee touching ready to eat cookies with the bare hands while wrapping the cookies individually for sale. Education was carried out. The behavior was abolished. Ensure that employees are aware and reminded to avoid touching or handling ready to eat food items with their bare hands at all times.
findings.citation_text: 3-301.11. (B) Preventing Contamination from Hands. (B) Except when washing fruits and vegetables as specified under §3-302.15 or as specified in (D) and (E) of this section, FOOD EMPLOYEES may not contact exposed, READY-TO-EAT FOOD with their bare hands and shall use suitable UTENSILS such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, single-use gloves, or dispensing EQUIPMENT.

findings.title: No bare-hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed.
findings.citation_text:
3-301.11. Inspector observed staff cutting raw ready to eat vegetables with bare hands. PIC was made aware of the incident. Staff was educated and the food in question was discarded. Staff proceeded to wash their hands and don gloves to continue the task. Ensure that staff are knowledgeable to don gloves during food prep to avoid contamination.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed a leakage in the standing cooler down in the basement. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensured inspectors that it was going to get fix. The facility has a rubber container at the top of the cooler shelf to catch the drips while they await the necessary repairs. Ensure that equipments are monitored and in good repair to avoid food contamination and spoilage.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: At the start of the inspection, the hand sink in the bar area was observed to be used for soaking coffee pots. These items were removed from the sink during the inspection and the hand sink became readily available. Ensure that the hand sink is used for no other purpose except for hand washing. 
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment: 410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.11: The ice machine behind the bar was observed to have an accumulation of mold/debris on the side walls. This item was cleaned and sanitized during today’s inspection. Ensure this item is cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain it clean. 
4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The prep cooler gaskets are observed to have an accumulation of soil/debris int eh crevices. Ensure the current buildup is cleaned and sanitized to remove the current accumulation. Ensure these gaskets are cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: The bar hand washing sink is observed to have many items stored in the sink basin during the inspection. Ensure the hand sink remains clear and accessible to employees and that it is not used for any other purpose except for hand washing. This is a repeat item from the previous inspection. 
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The coolers in the basement are observed to have an accumulation of soil/food debris in the bottom of the units. Ensure these surfaces are cleaned and sanitized and then cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean.
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: During the inspection, there was no Certified Food Manager present. Ensure a sufficient number of employees are certified in order to keep the facility staffed with a CFM present during all hours of operations. A CFM was present at the end of the inspection.
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: Employees were observed serving iced beverages without first washing their hands. Ensure employees are trained properly on when and how to wash their hands to prevent contamination. Instruction was provided to the present staff and hand washing was corrected with verbal education during the time of inspection.
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: The bar hand washing sink is observed to have many items stored in the sink basin during the inspection. Ensure the hand sink remains clear and accessible to employees and that it is not used for any other purpose except for hand washing. 
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: There are fresh mouse droppings observe din the basement kitchen area. Ensure a thorough cleaning is accomplished to remove the droppings and to monitor the progress of the pest eradication. A 10 day follow-up is being issued to observe this progress and it is set for Friday, June 24th, 2022. 
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The gasket of the white freezer in the basement area is in need of cleaning and sanitizing to remove the build up of debris. Ensure this surface is cleaned and sanitized and then cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of build up.
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The soda dispensing nozzle of the bar area was observed to have an excessive accumulation of mold and residues. This nozzle is being removed, cleaned and sanitized during the inspection. Ensure cleaning and sanitizing of this items occurs at a frequency to prevent this accumulation. 
(A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.
